classification: post-selection known-rule expressivity, not untouched final test or ONE_STANDARD qualification
derivation: From exhaustive saved every-slot failure records, without re-executing the model. No selected-query L1/identity statistic is claimed.
metrics: top-1 errors and probability-threshold errors for selected query; whole-scenario pass and unresolved/runtime counts, separate from every-slot metrics
selector: For event index i=0..31 select actor=(i//4)%4, object=i%4. For renamed scenarios apply its declared actor permutation to the selected actor; object stays unchanged.
